answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable 40 POA entry tax and stakes 60 POA locked for 20 epochs, and each taxed identity carries a violet marker. 100 fake agents cost 4,000 POA in sunk tax plus 6,000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays once and earns the stake back. Each payment settles like a shale layer, a record that cannot wander back as a refund, so fresh violet clusters are easy to spot. Cheating costs more than it earns.
